AppliqueParams.description:
Automatic appliqué: placement line → stop (lay the fabric)
→ tack-down → stop (trim the fabric) → cover stitch along the edge.

coverOffset.description: Shift of the cover stitch centre outwards (mm, negative = inwards).

flip.description: Swap the side E-stitch prongs point to.

stops.description: Machine stops after the placement line and after the tack-down.

tackdownInset.description: Distance of the tack-down centre inside the edge (mm).

oneOf.description: A rectangle around the design.
Follows the outline of the design.

CarvePattern.description:
Penetration patterns carved into a tatami fill (program split /
carving): the needle points line up into a pattern that catches the light.

CloneLink.description: A clone's link to its original (see [`Object::clone`]).

angle.description: The clone's own fill angle (Ink/Stitch clone `angle`).

m.description: Original → clone transform (a b c d e f, mm) and the rotation in it (degrees).

CoverMode.description: Whether an object hides the stitching under it.

oneOf.description: By the design's rules (width, row spacing, texture, appliqué).
Always, even when thin or open.
Never: what's under it is stitched in full.
Both diagonals (×).
One diagonal (/).
Upright cross (+).

× and + together: one diagonal, the upright cross, the other
diagonal on top (Ink/Stitch double cross).
Smyrna cross: the diagonal cross, then the upright cross on top.

Cutter.description: What a machine's thread cutter cuts.

oneOf.description: Every trim command.

Only jumps longer than its trimming length (Brother and Baby Lock
home machines: 5 mm by default).
No cutter: every jump is snipped by hand.

DensityRamp.description:
A density gradient along a vector (design mm): row spacing `dense` at
`from`, `sparse` at `to` (shaped by the profile), constant beyond.

additive.description:
Interpolate the density (rows per mm), not the spacing: two layers
with opposite ramps add up to an even coverage (colour blending).

dense.description: Row spacing where the fill is densest (mm).

group.description: The two layers of a colour blend share a group.

reverse.description: Sparse at `from`, dense at `to` (the other layer of a colour blend).

sparse.description: Row spacing where it is most open (mm).

DesignOptions.description:
Design-wide stitch processing applied when the plan is built
(non-destructive: the objects themselves are not changed).

appliqueCovers.description: An appliqué's fabric hides what's under it.

basting.description: Basting stitched first to hold fabric and stabiliser together.

bastingMargin.description: Distance of the basting from the design (mm).

coverMaxSpacing.description:
Fills and satins with rows further apart than this are open and
don't hide what's under them, mm.

coverMinWidth.description:
Objects with no part at least this wide don't hide what's under
them (outlines, thin borders, narrow satins), mm.

keepUnderlay.description:
Keep the full underlay under the parts that are removed (steadier
fabric under the object on top).

knockdown.description:
Knockdown (laydown stitch): a light net sewn first under the
whole design to flatten the nap of towels, fleece and fur, so the
embroidery does not sink in.

knockdownColor.description: Thread colour (#rrggbb): usually the fabric's, so it disappears.

knockdownHoles.description: Leave the design's holes (letter counters, gaps) unflattened.

knockdownLayers.description: One layer, or two crossing at 90° (denser nap).

knockdownOffset.description: How far the knockdown reaches beyond the design (mm).

knockdownSpacing.description: Row distance of the net (mm) and its stitch length (mm).

minFragment.description:
Leftover pieces (and holes) smaller than this are not worth a
jump: pieces are dropped, holes stitched over, mm².

origin.description:
The point that becomes 0,0 in machine files (Ink/Stitch "origin"
command); none: the centre of the design.

overlapMargin.description: How far a lower fill still reaches under the object above (mm).

removeOverlaps.description: Remove fill stitching hidden under objects stacked on top (remove overlaps).

stopPosition.description:
Where the frame moves before every stop (Ink/Stitch "stop position",
a.k.a. frame out), so the operator can reach the fabric; none: it stays.

texturedCovers.description: Textured fills (stipple, meander, Hilbert, cross stitch) hide what's under them.

threadWeight.description:
Thread weight of the top thread (No. 40 = the standard); scales
satin and fill spacing (`thread_density_scale`).

trimRunning.description: Running stitches under a cover are removed too.

DitherMethod.description: How the colours are mixed where they overlap in the transition (dithered gradients).

oneOf.description: Error diffusion (Floyd–Steinberg): the most even mix.
Whole rows interleave in an ordered pattern.
Bayer matrix: a regular woven / pixel look.
Random blue-ish noise: organic, painterly.
No mixing: hard edges at the middle of each transition.
Ink/Stitch "tatami fill" (auto fill): parallel staggered rows.
Concentric inset rings (Ink/Stitch contour fill, inner-to-outer).
Continuous spiral built from inset rings.
New: sunburst rays from a centre with density-preserving short rays.
New: Hilbert space-filling curve texture.
New: tonal stipple (Poisson-disk points joined by a TSP tour).
Ink/Stitch meander fill: a random space-filling walk over a lattice.
Ink/Stitch guided fill: rows follow a guide line.
Ink/Stitch circular fill: a spiral around a centre point.

Streamline fill: evenly spaced rows following a direction field
(from the digitizer: the flow of the picture; without one, the shape).

Curved fill: streamline rows that follow the outline of the shape
(with a mesh gradient: the rows of the mesh); `curve` sets how much.
Cross stitch: a grid of crosses over the shape (Ink/Stitch cross stitch).
Tartan: a woven plaid, one colour per layer (Ink/Stitch tartan fill).

angle.description: Row direction in degrees (counter-clockwise on screen).

carve.description: Tatami: a pattern carved into the needle points.

center.description: Radial fill centre relative to the shape bounding box (0..1).

centerOut.description:
Tatami: start in the middle and sew outwards to either side, so the
fabric is pushed out evenly rather than all towards one end.

contourClockwise.description:
Contour / spiral: go round clockwise on screen (Ink/Stitch
`clockwise`, default true). Stored as `contourClockwise`: documents
before it stored `clockwise` with the opposite meaning (true went
round counter-clockwise on screen); they are read flipped, so they
sew as before (see [`FillParams`]'s `Deserialize`).

contourDouble.description:
Spiral contour: in on every other ring and out on the rest, ending
next to the start (Ink/Stitch `contour_strategy` = double spiral).

crossDense.description: Upright crosses: a second grid shifted by half a cell (dense upright).

crossFlip.description: Cross stitch: the other diagonal first (Ink/Stitch's "flipped" methods).

crossGridCanvas.description:
Cross stitch grid on the page (true: neighbouring areas line up), or
on the shape's own corner (false: the shape stitches the same wherever
it is — Ink/Stitch's cross-stitch fonts). Ink/Stitch `canvas_grid_origin`.

crossMaxLength.description: Cross stitch: split stitches longer than this (mm, 0 = never).

crossOffset.description: Shift of the cross stitch grid (mm, x y). Ink/Stitch `cross_offset_mm`.

crossSize.description:
Cross stitch: cell size (mm), how much of a cell must be inside the
shape (0..1) and the stitches of a cell.

crossSizeY.description: Cross stitch: cell height (mm; 0 = square). Ink/Stitch `pattern_size_mm` "x y".

crossThreads.description: Cross stitch: every diagonal sewn this many times (odd: 1, 3, 5).

curve.description:
Curved fill: 0 = straight rows along the fill angle, 1 = rows follow
the outline fully.

endRowSpacing.description: Optional gradient: row spacing at the end of the fill (0 = disabled).

expand.description:
Grow (or with < 0 shrink) the shape before fill stitching, against
gaps between shapes (mm). Ink/Stitch `expand_mm`.

flow.description: Flow fill: the direction field the rows follow.

flowAcross.description:
Flow fill of a gradient: rows run across the colour bands (through
the colours) instead of along them.

gapFillRows.description:
Tatami: extra rows sewn past the end of each section before it
travels on, against gaps between sections on stretchy fabric
(Ink/Stitch `gap_fill_rows`; rounded up to an even number).

gradient.description: Multi-colour gradient: this fill is one colour layer of it.

gradientDensity.description:
With an end row spacing: interpolate the stitch *density* (rows per
mm) instead of the spacing, so two overlapping fills with opposite
gradients add up to an even coverage (colour blending).

guide.description: Guided fill: the guide line the rows follow (design coordinates).

guidedStrategy.description: Guided fill: copies of the guide, or rows parallel to it.

meanderAspect.description:
Meander: height of the pattern relative to its width (Ink/Stitch's
separate x / y `meander_scale_percent`; 1 = as drawn).

meanderClip.description:
Meander: keep the stitches inside the shape (with smoothing or
expand they can leave it). Ink/Stitch `clip`.

meanderPattern.description: Meander fill: lattice, cell size (mm), smoothness (0..1) and seed.

meanderTile.description:
Meander fill: an Ink/Stitch tile (`tiles/<id>`) instead of the lattice;
`meander_scale` 2.5 mm ≙ the tile at 100 %.

meanderZigzag.description:
Meander: sewn as a zig-zag of this zig+zag length (mm, 0 = a plain
line) and width. Ink/Stitch `zigzag_spacing_mm`, `zigzag_width_mm`.

pullCompPct.description:
Tatami: pull compensation as a share of each row's length, each side
(Ink/Stitch `pull_compensation_percent`, here 0..1).

ramp.description:
Density gradient along a vector (a gradient fill and, as two
layers with opposite ramps, colour blending). Tatami, flow and curved.

randomLength.description:
Random stitch length in the rows (tatami, contour, guided, circular,
spiral): each stitch varies by up to this % (0 = even). Ink/Stitch
`random_stitch_length_jitter_percent`.

repeats.description:
Running-style fills (meander, circular, contour, spiral): the path sewn
this many times, and every stitch as a bean stitch (Ink/Stitch
`repeats`, `bean_stitch_repeats`).

seed.description: Seed of the meander and of random stitch lengths.

skipLast.description:
Tatami: leave out the last stitch of every row (it sits next to the
first of the next one). Ink/Stitch `skip_last`.

staggers.description: Rows repeat their stitch pattern every N rows (tatami stagger).

tartan.description: Tartan: this fill is one colour layer of it.

tatamiRoute.description:
Tatami (rows and underlay): one way from top to bottom, or Ink/Stitch's
stitch path. Centre out goes first.

travelLength.description: Stitch length for travel/underpath running stitches.

underlayAngle.description: Underlay angle relative to the fill angle (degrees).

underlayAngles.description:
Underlay passes at these angles (relative to the fill angle); when
set, they replace the underlay angle and the cross-hatch. Ink/Stitch
`fill_underlay_angle` with several values.

underlayAuto.description:
Underlay chosen by the object's size and the fabric (automatic
underlay); the manual underlay settings are ignored then.

underlayCross.description:
A second tatami underlay pass, the two crossing at ±45° to the
underlay angle (Ink/Stitch: a list of underlay angles; a double
tatami underlay) — for soft and stretchy fabrics.

underlayEdge.description:
An edge run (running stitch just inside the outline) before the
tatami underlay: crisp, stable edges.

underlaySkipLast.description: Underlay: leave out the last stitch of every row too.

underpath.description:
Travel inside the shape between sections (off: along the outline
only). Ink/Stitch `underpath`.

FlowField.description:
A direction field on a grid (design mm): row directions in radians
(y down, defined modulo π), row-major `cols × rows` cells of `cell` mm.

FreePoint.description: A colour point of a freeform gradient.

spread.description: Reach of the colour (mm): a larger spread carries it further before it blends.

oneOf.description: Mirrored around the start point.
Sweeps around the start point.

Gradient mesh: a grid of coloured nodes, blended
smoothly inside every patch.
Freeform colour points, each with its own spread.

GradientMesh.description: `rows` × `cols` nodes, row by row; four neighbouring nodes span a patch.

GradientMix.description: How a gradient's colours share the shape.

oneOf.description:
The colours share one set of full-density rows: every stretch of a
row is sewn by one colour, picked by an ordered dither across the
rows, so a colour takes more rows where it is stronger and the
density stays even. A row changes colour where its colour fades.

The rows are cut into cells, each sewn in one colour (dithered): a
crisp pixel mix, at the cost of a jump at most cell borders of the
last colour. Straight rows only.

Every row in one colour, the colours alternating rows through the
transition (Ink/Stitch's linear gradient fill); every colour travels
along the outline only. Straight rows only; best across the gradient.

GradientParams.description:
A gradient over several fill layers (one object per colour stop, all
with the same shape and stitch grid); the layers share every row of the
grid between them, so the total density stays even.

cell.description: Dither cell length along the rows (mm).

from.description: Start and end of the gradient vector (mm).

group.description: Shared id of the layers of one gradient.

mix.description: Blend the colours by density, or dither them cell by cell.

points.description: Colour points of a freeform gradient.

mid.description: Midpoint of the transition to the next stop (0..1, 0.5 = even).

GuidedStrategy.description: How a guided fill's rows follow its guide line (Ink/Stitch `guided_fill_strategy`).

oneOf.description: Every row a copy of the guide, shifted across (rows bunch where it bends).
Rows parallel to the guide at an even distance (offset curves).
Like parallel, and round the guide's ends.

HiddenRule.description: An object's own setting for hidden stitching.

covers.description: Does it hide what's under it?

keep.description: Keep all of its own stitches, even where something hides them.

oneOf.description: An ellipse in the width × height box (round when they are equal).

LockOverride.description: An object's own lock stitches; `None` fields: the machine's.

startLength.description: Length of the back-and-forth lock (mm), Ink/Stitch `lock_start_scale_mm` / `lock_end_scale_mm`.

startScale.description: Size of the shape locks (%), Ink/Stitch `lock_start_scale_percent` / `lock_end_scale_percent`.

oneOf.description: Half a stitch back and forth along the path (Ink/Stitch's default).
Back and forth over a fixed length (`lock_length`).

cutter.description:
The thread cutter: which trims the machine really cuts (the UI's
preview and hand-trim count, `ui/src/lib/cuts.ts`; the plan and the
files are the same either way).

lockLength.description: Length of the back-and-forth lock (mm, Ink/Stitch `lock_*_scale_mm`).

lockScale.description: Size of the shape locks (%, Ink/Stitch `lock_*_scale_percent`).

lockStart.description:
Lock stitch shapes at the start and the end of a stitch run
(Ink/Stitch `lock_start` / `lock_end`).

maxStitch.description: Maximum single needle movement before splitting (mm).

minStitch.description: Minimum stitch length; shorter stitches are dropped (mm).

profile.description: The machine / settings preset these came from (UI id; informational).

spm.description: Machine speed for time estimates (stitches per minute).

trimDistance.description: Jumps longer than this become trims (mm).

trimSeconds.description: Seconds per trim / colour change for time estimates.

ManualParams.description: Manual stitch: every node is a needle penetration.

beanPattern.description: Bean repeats per stitch (passes; several values are used in turn).

maxLength.description:
Split stitches longer than this (mm, 0 = keep them).
Ink/Stitch `max_stitch_length_mm`.

MeanderPattern.description: Lattice the meander fill walks on.

oneOf.description: Square grid: classic meander with right-angle turns.
Triangular grid: zig-zagging, angular wandering.
Honeycomb: hexagonal, organic wandering.

MeshNode.description: A node of a gradient mesh.

c.description: Colour layer (stop index) of this node.

MotifParams.description: Motif run: a pattern repeated along the line.

size.description: Length of one motif along the line (mm); its height is half of it.

Node.description: A cubic-bezier node: anchor plus optional absolute in/out handles.

clone.description:
A linked clone (an SVG `<use>`): it follows another object through
its own transform; the editor keeps its shape in step.

colorSortIndex.description:
Ink/Stitch `color_sort_index` (lettering fonts): the place of this
object's colour when a lettering is sewn colour by colour.

end.description: Where stitching should end (Ink/Stitch "ending point" / "fill end" command).

forceLock.description:
Lock stitches even where the object joins the next one without a
trim (Ink/Stitch `force_lock_stitches`).

hidden.description: How this object takes part in removing hidden stitching (none: automatic).

lock.description:
This object's own lock stitches (Ink/Stitch per-element `lock_start`,
`lock_end`, `lock_*_scale_*`); what's left out comes from the machine.

minJump.description:
Gaps to the next object up to this long are sewn through without
locks and a trim (mm; none: the machine's trim distance).
Ink/Stitch `min_jump_stitch_length_mm`.

minStitch.description:
Drop stitches shorter than this in this object (mm; none: the
machine setting). Ink/Stitch `min_stitch_length_mm`.

patterns.description: Stitch patterns drawn over the object (Ink/Stitch pattern markers).

start.description: Where stitching should begin (Ink/Stitch "starting point" / "fill start" command).

stopAfter.description: Insert a machine stop after this object (appliqué, puff, ...).

ties.description: Lock stitches at this object's start and end (Ink/Stitch `ties`).

trimAfter.description: Insert a trim after this object even if the next one is close.

oneOf.description: Reverse the second rail when it runs against the first.

RampProfile.description: How the density changes along a ramp: 0 = densest, 1 = sparsest.

oneOf.description: Stays dense, then opens up quickly.
Opens up quickly, then stays open.
An S-curve: dense and open ends, a soft transition.
Dense in the middle, open at both ends.
Open in the middle, dense at both ends.

RippleGuidePosition.description: Where copies sit along a satin guide (Ink/Stitch `satin_guide_pattern_position`).

RippleParams.description:
Ripple stitch (Ink/Stitch `ripple_stitch.py`): closed shapes become a
spiral of shrinking copies of the outline (circular ripples), open lines
are stitched back and forth as parallel copies (linear ripples).

anchor.description:
Satin guide: the line of the outline fitted between the rails
(default: from its first to its last point).

exponent.description: Bunch the ripples towards one end (> 1) or the other (< 1), and flip it.

fan.description:
Open lines without a guide: fanned towards the target (Ink/Stitch)
instead of parallel copies `spacing` apart.

flipCopies.description: Sew every other copy backwards (back and forth); off: all one way.

gridSize.description:
A grid across the ripples, its points this far apart (mm, 0 = none),
sewn after the ripples or first.

guide.description:
The guide the copies follow: one line, or a satin (two rails and
rungs) the copies are fitted between.

guidePosition.description: Satin guide: copies by line count, at the rungs, or as many as fit.

joinPoint.description:
Copies meet in points (Ink/Stitch join style "point") instead of
flat connections.

manual.description: The outline's own points are the stitches (no running stitch).

minLineDist.description:
Lines at least this far apart instead of a fixed count (mm, 0 = use
`lines`). Ink/Stitch `min_line_dist_mm`.

minScale.description: Closed shapes: size of the innermost ripple (0..1 of the outline).

reverse.description: Start in the middle (closed) / at the far copy (open).

rotation.description: Total rotation from the first to the last ripple (degrees).

scaleAxis.description:
Copies along a guide: scaled on these axes, from `scale_start` to
`scale_end` % (Ink/Stitch's default end is 0 %; here 100 %), turned
with the guide.

skipStart.description: Leave out this many ripples at the start / end.

spacing.description: Open lines: distance between the copies (mm).

staggers.description: Rows of needle points staggered over this many lines (0 = even stitches).

target.description: Centre of the ripples (closed) or the direction to ripple towards (open). Default: the shape's centre.

RippleScaleAxis.description: Which axes ripple copies are scaled on (Ink/Stitch `scale_axis`).

beanPattern.description:
Bean repeats per stitch in turn (passes, like `bean_repeats`);
overrides `bean_repeats` when set.

beanRepeats.description: Bean stitch: each stitch is repeated this many extra times back and forth (0, 2, 4..).

cutworkNeedle.description:
Cutwork: the needle (knife, 1–4) that cuts this line, 0 = none.
Ink/Stitch `cutwork_needle`.

lengthPattern.description:
Several stitch lengths used in turn (Ink/Stitch "2 1"); overrides
`length` when set.

motif.description: Motif run: a small pattern repeated along the line.

randomLength.description:
Random stitch length: each stitch varies by up to this % (0 = even
stitches). Ink/Stitch `random_stitch_length_jitter_percent`.

repeats.description: Number of passes along the path (1 = single, 2 = there and back, ...).

ripple.description: Ripple stitch (Ink/Stitch): the line is repeated as ripples.

stem.description: Stem stitch: slanted stitches that overlap by half — a rope.

tolerance.description: Curve tolerance (mm) for the sleeve fitting algorithm.

centerWalkRepeats.description:
Centre walk: passes along the centre (2 = there and back), and where
across the column (0 = first rail, 0.5 = centre, 1 = second rail).
Ink/Stitch `center_walk_underlay_repeats` / `_position`.

contourInsetPct.description:
Contour / zig-zag underlay inset as a share of the column width, each
side (Ink/Stitch `*_underlay_inset_percent`, here 0..1).

guides.description:
Direction guides: lines across the column that set the stitch angle
there (Ink/Stitch rungs); between two guides the angle turns evenly.
Kept apart from the paths so editing the outline keeps them.

maxStitchLength.description: Split stitches longer than this (mm). 0 = never.

multi.description: Every sub-path is its own centre-line column (e.g. satin borders around letters).

pullComp.description: Pull compensation in mm (added to the total width).

pullCompPct.description: Pull compensation as percentage of the local width.

pushComp.description:
Shortens the column at both ends: satins push the fabric out where
they start and end (mm; Ink/Stitch `push_compensation_mm`).

randomSpacing.description:
Random zig-zag spacing: each stitch's distance to the next varies by
up to this share (0..1). Ink/Stitch `random_zigzag_spacing_percent`.

randomWider.description:
Random texture: every stitch up to this much wider / narrower (share of
the width, each side) — Ink/Stitch `random_width_increase/decrease_percent`.

reverseRails.description:
Which rail runs the wrong way (Ink/Stitch `reverse_rails`):
detected automatically, or set when a satin renders strangely.

secondRail.description: The second rail's own values where Ink/Stitch gives two ("0.2 0.5").

shortStitchDistance.description:
Stitches in tight curves closer than this get shortened (mm;
Ink/Stitch `short_stitch_distance_mm`).

shortStitchInset.description: Shorten every other stitch in tight curves (0..1 fraction inset).

splitJitter.description:
Split stitches: positions (or, with a random phase, lengths) vary by
up to this share (0..1). Ink/Stitch `random_split_jitter_percent`.

splitMinLength.description:
With a random phase: stitches longer than this are split already
(mm, 0 = the max stitch length). Ink/Stitch `min_random_split_length_mm`.

splitRandomPhase.description:
Split stitches with a random phase instead of centred (no lines of
split points). Ink/Stitch `random_split_phase`.

splitStaggers.description:
Long stitches split at staggered points (rows of needle points would
line up otherwise): every `split_staggers` stitches the pattern repeats
(0 = split evenly; Ink/Stitch `split_method` staggered).

underlayAuto.description:
Underlay chosen by the column's width and the fabric (automatic
underlay); the manual underlay switches are ignored then.

underlayStitchLength.description: Stitch length of the centre-walk and contour underlay (mm).

width.description: Width when the satin is defined by a single centre line (mm).

zigzagUnderlayMaxStitch.description: Zig-zag underlay: split stitches longer than this (mm, 0 = never).

SecondRail.description:
A satin's settings for its second rail where Ink/Stitch gives two values
("0.2 0.5": first rail, second rail); `None`: the same as the first.

StemParams.description: Stem stitch (hand embroidery's stem / outline stitch).

width.description: Width of the rope (mm): how far the stitches slant across the line.

oneOf.description: Shape is shown but not stitched (e.g. appliqué artwork reference).
Every node is a needle penetration (imported embroidery files).

StitchPattern.description:
A user-drawn stitch pattern (Ink/Stitch "selection to pattern"):
lines add a needle point wherever a stitch crosses them (every
`interval`-th crossing, after skipping `offset`), shapes leave out the
needle points inside them (row ends and satin edges stay).

add.description: Lines: add needle points where stitches cross them.

interval.description: Which crossings get a point, in turn (1 = every one, "2 1" …).

remove.description: Shapes: leave out the needle points inside them.

TartanParams.description: A tartan (Ink/Stitch `inkstitch:tartan` settings and tartan fill parameters).

angle.description: The rows' angle to the stripes (degrees; Ink/Stitch `tartan_angle`, -45).

group.description: Shared id of the layers of one tartan.

herringbone.description: Herringbone: the twill turns every this many mm (0 = a plain twill).

layer.description: Which colour of the palette this layer sews.

minStripeWidth.description: Stripes this narrow or narrower are sewn as running stitch lines (mm).

offset.description: Shift of the stripes (mm, x y).

palette.description:
Ink/Stitch's palette code: `(colour)width` stripes, `/` a symmetric
sett, `?` not sewn, `*` in the previous colour, `warp|weft`.

rowsPerThread.description: Rows of one thread before warp and weft change over.

symmetry.description: Reflect the sett at its pivots (also when the code has no `/`).

TatamiRoute.description: The order a tatami sews its rows in.

oneOf.description:
Every part from its top row down to its bottom row, the parts from
the top of the design down: the fabric is pushed one way only, never
caught between two halves sewn towards each other.

Ink/Stitch's stitch path (`auto_fill`): it ends where it started, so
a shape is often sewn in two halves that meet in the middle.

weight.description:
Weight number (No. 40 …) when it differs from the design's thread
weight: sizes the thread in the density model.

ThreadSource.description: A thread's original colour (its "need") before fitting.

TransitionCurve.description: How a colour changes into the next between two stops.

oneOf.description: Steep S-curve: short transitions, long solid areas.
Posterised into `steps` hard bands.

ZigzagParams.description: Zig-zag line: the line sewn as a simple zig-zag of its stroke width.

angle.description: Turn the zig-zags by this angle (degrees, ±89): spokes on curves.

spacing.description: Length of one zig and zag together (mm).

threadLocks.description: Threads that keep their spool when fitting.

threadSources.description:
The colours threads had before they were fitted to a chart or to the
user's spools (thread id → original): fitting and merging stay reversible.
